segments.name: American Eagle brand
products: casual, comfortable, timeless outfitting and high-quality products
segments.description: Sells casual clothing and accessories under the American Eagle brand in stores and online.
segments.evidence: We offer casual, comfortable, timeless outfitting and high-quality products that are made to last under the American Eagle ("AE") brand, and intimates, apparel, activewear, and swim collections under the Aerie and OFFLINE by Aerie brands.

segments.name: Aerie brand
segments.description: Sells intimates, apparel, activewear and swimwear under the Aerie and OFFLINE by Aerie brands.
segments.evidence: We offer casual, comfortable, timeless outfitting and high-quality products that are made to last under the American Eagle ("AE") brand, and intimates, apparel, activewear, and swim collections under the Aerie and OFFLINE by Aerie brands.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Holds the Todd Snyder and Unsubscribed brands, below the reporting threshold.
segments.evidence: Additionally, our Todd Snyder and Unsubscribed brands have been identified as separate operating segments; however, as they do not meet the quantitative thresholds for separate disclosure they are presented under the Other caption.

revenueModel.text: Shoppers buy its clothing and accessories in stores, online and through concession shops.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell directly to consumers through our retail channels, which includes online, stores, and concession-based shops-within-shops.

changes.text: Closed the Quiet Platforms business in fiscal 2025 and stopped serving third-party customers.
changes.evidence: In Fiscal 2025, as part of our continued supply chain network optimization project, we made the decision to close the Quiet Platforms business and discontinue services for all third-party customers.
